Class Coordinate

Namespace
Deodesy.Library

Represents a point on the Earth's surface using Latitude and Longitude.

Initializes a new instance of the Coordinate class.

public Coordinate(double latitude = 0, double longitude = 0)

Parameters

latitude double

The latitude in degrees (-90 to 90). Defaults to 0.

longitude double

The longitude in degrees (-180 to 180). Defaults to 0.

Examples

var coord1 = new Coordinate(); // Latitude: 0, Longitude: 0
var coord2 = new Coordinate(30, -120); // Latitude: 30, Longitude: -120

Properties

Latitude

Gets or sets the latitude in degrees. The value is wrapped to the range -90 to 90.

public double Latitude { get; set; }

Property Value

double

Examples

var coord = new Coordinate(95, 0);
Console.WriteLine(coord.Latitude); // Output: 85

LatitudeR

Returns Latitude in Radians.

public double LatitudeR { get; }

Property Value

double

Examples

var coord = new Coordinate(90, 0);
Console.WriteLine(coord.LatitudeR); // Output: 1.5707963267948966 (PI/2)

Longitude

Gets or sets the longitude in degrees. The value is wrapped to the range -180 to 180.

public double Longitude { get; set; }

Property Value

double

Examples

var coord = new Coordinate(0, 185);
Console.WriteLine(coord.Longitude); // Output: 182.5

LongitudeR

Returns Longitude in Radians.

public double LongitudeR { get; }

Property Value

double

Examples

var coord = new Coordinate(0, 180);
Console.WriteLine(coord.LongitudeR); // Output: 3.141592653589793 (PI)
